title: Meta-Harness:每题 frontier,和更宽的历史
note: 移植的是它的 frontier 规则(`update_frontier`):**每题**记录最佳候选与通过率,外加总体最佳;下一轮建在总体最佳那个**已 staged** 的状态上。proposer 读的是**所有**历史候选的源码、分数和 trace(不只是上一轮),这是它论文的主张所在。原实现的 validate+smoke 门带不过来(mode A 交出去的候选就是被测对象,方法不能先单题试跑),Claude Code 的工具面也换成了共用 editor;它的搜索集与报告集是同一批 89 题,我们分开。见 docs/methods_we_port.md §6。

deviations.what: A different experiment on a different model, not a reproduction.
deviations.why: Their default is 89 tasks x 2 trials at concurrency 50 on Opus 4.6 with an optional `--full-eval` 5-trial winner pass; ours is the shared editor with the run's own trials.

deviations.what: History depth is the newest 12 states, not every prior candidate.
deviations.why: `STATES_KEPT`; every curve point is still on disk, but the proposer does not see all prior source and traces.
mode A cannot smoke-test: a candidate that is handed over *is* evaluated, so the gate can only move to 'do not spend this round'.
